overview.purpose_zh: 这张和弦图用来看团队之间互相发送请求的双向关系：谁向谁要得多，谁收到的多，哪两个团队联系最紧密。
works_zh: 适合展示有两个方向的关系，比如互发请求、互相引用。
适合找出网络里的中心节点，以及明显不对等的往来。

understanding.read_zh: 先看外圈每个团队占的弧长，那是它发出和收到的总量；再看圆内部的带子，带子两端连着两个团队，宽度代表请求量。同一对团队有去有回，就是双向流量。

elements.note_zh: 每个团队在外圈占一段弧，弧越长，它参与的请求总量越大。
连接两个团队的带子，宽度表示两地之间的请求量。
带子从发送方连到接收方，同一对团队可以有两条方向相反的带子。
两个团队互相发送的数量是否接近，就是往来的对等程度。

look_for_zh: 最宽的带子连接哪两个团队
哪些团队收到的远多于发出的

observations.en: Design and Engineering exchange the most: Design sends 42 requests a week to Engineering, and 28 come back.
observations.zh: 设计和工程之间的往来最多：设计每周向工程发 42 个请求，工程回发 28 个。

observations.en: Design is the hub of the diagram: it receives 82 requests a week from Engineering, Product, and Marketing, and sends 62.
observations.zh: 设计是这张图的中心：它每周从工程、产品和市场收到 82 个请求，同时发出 62 个。

observations.en: Engineering receives 94 requests a week, more than any other team, and sends 62.
observations.zh: 工程每周收到 94 个请求，比任何团队都多，同时发出 62 个。

observations.en: Product sends 61 requests and receives 62, so its two-way traffic is almost balanced.
observations.zh: 产品发出 61 个请求，收到 62 个，双向流量几乎持平。

observations.en: Marketing sends 40 requests, with 22 going to Product and 18 to Design.
observations.zh: 市场发出 40 个请求，其中 22 个给产品，18 个给设计。

observations.en: Support sends 26 requests, split between Engineering (15) and Product (11).
observations.zh: 支持团队发出 26 个请求，分给工程（15 个）和产品（11 个）。

describe.en: The chord diagram shows how six teams send requests to one another each week.
describe.zh: 这张和弦图展示六个团队每周如何互相发送请求。
describe.pattern: The chart shows + what + for whom + over what period
alternatives: The chart shows weekly requests between six teams.
The diagram maps the two-way traffic among six teams.

describe.en: The flow from Design to Engineering is 42 requests a week, while 28 flow back.
describe.zh: 从设计流向工程的流量是每周 42 个请求，同时有 28 个流回来。
describe.pattern: the flow of + noun + from ... to ... / flow into + place
alternatives: The flow into Engineering from Design is 42 requests a week.
28 requests flow from Engineering back to Design.

describe.en: Design's 42 requests to Engineering are higher than the 28 that return.
describe.zh: 设计发给工程的 42 个请求，高于工程回发的 28 个。
describe.pattern: A + be + higher than + B / higher than + figure
alternatives: Design sends more requests than it receives from Engineering, 42 against 28.
The return flow of 28 is lower than Design's 42.

describe.en: Product's totals are on a par with each other: 61 requests sent and 62 received.
describe.zh: 产品的两个方向不相上下：发出 61 个请求，收到 62 个。
describe.pattern: A + be + on a par with + B
alternatives: Product's outgoing and incoming volumes are roughly equal, 61 and 62.
Product sends and receives almost the same number of requests.

describe.en: The diagram shows a two-way relationship between Design and Engineering, with 42 requests out and 28 back.
describe.zh: 这张图显示设计和工程之间存在双向关系：发出去 42 个请求，回来 28 个。
describe.pattern: the chart shows a relationship between A and B
alternatives: The chart shows a clear relationship between Design and Engineering.
Requests run in both directions between Design and Engineering.

describe.en: Engineering holds the largest share of incoming requests, 94 a week, while Design receives 82.
describe.zh: 工程收到的请求份额最大，每周 94 个；设计收到 82 个。
describe.pattern: X has / holds / takes the largest share of + whole
alternatives: Engineering takes the largest share of incoming requests at 94 a week.
No team receives more than Engineering, which gets 94 requests a week.

describe.en: I'd like to highlight the imbalance between Design and Engineering: 42 requests go out and 28 come back.
describe.zh: 我想重点强调设计和工程之间的不对等：发出去 42 个请求，只回来 28 个。
describe.pattern: I'd like to highlight + noun / the fact that + clause
alternatives: I'd like to highlight one number: Design sends 42 requests a week to Engineering.
The key point to highlight is the 42 to 28 split between Design and Engineering.

academic.en: The chord diagram maps weekly requests between six teams in a software company. Design sends 42 requests to Engineering and receives 28 in return. Product sends 36 to Design and receives 20 back, while Marketing sends 18 to Design and 22 to Product. Engineering receives 94 requests in total and sends 62; Design receives 82 and sends 62. Smaller flows run between Engineering and QA, 34 and 12, and from Support, 15 to Engineering and 11 to Product.
academic.zh: 这张和弦图展示一家软件公司六个团队之间每周的请求往来。设计向工程发 42 个请求，收到 28 个回发。产品向设计发 36 个，收到 20 个；市场向设计发 18 个，向产品发 22 个。工程一共收到 94 个请求，发出 62 个；设计收到 82 个，发出 62 个。工程和 QA 之间还有较小的流量，分别为 34 个和 12 个；支持团队发出 15 个给工程、11 个给产品。

business.en: Design is the hub of the request network: it receives 82 requests a week and sends 62, and its link with Engineering is the heaviest two-way exchange at 42 out and 28 back. Engineering carries the highest inbound load at 94, so its capacity looks like the main constraint. Product's traffic is balanced at 61 out and 62 in. Leaders should watch the Design to Engineering link first, because a backlog there slows both teams.
business.zh: 设计是请求网络的中心：每周收到 82 个请求，发出 62 个，它和工程之间的往来最重，发出去 42 个、回来 28 个。工程收到的量最大，每周 94 个，所以它的处理能力看起来是主要瓶颈。产品的双向流量基本持平，发出 61 个、收到 62 个。管理者应该先盯设计和工程这条线，因为这里积压会同时拖慢两个团队。

simple.en: The circle shows who asks whom for help at work. Design sends 42 requests a week to Engineering, and Engineering sends 28 back. Product asks Design 36 times and gets 20 requests in return. Engineering receives 94 requests in all, the most of any team. Design receives 82 and sends 62. The bands go both ways, so every team depends on the others.
simple.zh: 这个圆图展示工作中谁向谁求助。设计每周向工程发 42 个请求，工程回发 28 个。产品向设计发 36 个，也收到 20 个回发。工程一共收到 94 个请求，是所有团队里最多的。设计收到 82 个，发出 62 个。带子两个方向都有，说明每个团队都依赖其他团队。

language_notes.body_zh: send to 只说明方向；send back 强调回过来的那一份。写双向关系时，两个方向要分别给数，否则读者会以为只有一边。
examples: Engineering sends 28 requests back to Design.

language_notes.body_zh: receive 的主语是收的一方，send 的主语是发的一方。同一个团队的进出要分开说：Design receives 82 and sends 62，不要合并成一个数。
examples: Design receives 82 requests a week and sends 62.

language_notes.body_zh: more than 后面跟一条具体的线，比如 more than 80；the most 是跟所有团队比出来的最高级。两者可以一起用，但不要写成 more than the most。
examples: Design receives more than 80 requests a week.
Engineering receives 94 requests, the most of any team.
